key_concepts: Weather elements include humidity, atmospheric pressure, air temperature, rainfall, cloud
Weather instruments are used to measure weather elements
Weather symbols represent weather conditions and have meanings
Precautionary measures help protect people from weather conditions
Weather observations can be recorded in a local weather chart over time
Temperature data can be averaged and described as increasing or decreasing
Cloud conditions can be described by amount, color, shape, and placement
Sunlight amount can be observed and compared across days
Wind can be described by movement or speed
Rainfall amount can be observed and compared across days
Patterns in weather data can be used to make predictions or forecasts
